data.gender_notes: Mahabad is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'mahaba' meaning 'love' and 'Allah' meaning 'God'. Mahabad signifies being guided and protected by God. The name Mahabad carries the meaning “Guided by God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahabad usually hope their child will grow to embody guided by god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mahabad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guided by God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahabad total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
